packagePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the installed pi extension's package directory (e.g. ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/ghoseb/pi-askuserquestion). The agent walks this tree and scans per briefing.md § Scope priority order.

source.description: Optional original manifest source string (e.g. 'npm:pi-lean-ctx' or 'git:github.com/owner/repo'). Recorded in findings for provenance; not used for scan logic.
